I once pretended to have my foot run over so that my little brother wouldn't tell my mom i ate his chocolate bar.

It worked.

In fact, my mother rushed home from work to find my foot completely fine. She quickly saw through my lie and promptly grounded for me a week (with no sweets). My brother (to this day) completely forgot about the chocolate.

The whole "Die with the lie" thing is what made me giggles at my screen.

Simple, funny +1

item.title: This is an utterly idiotic concept
